capabilities: Play link and local videos in a draggable player window
Convert Bilibili, Douyin, WeChat, netdisk and web links into notes
Insert timestamped links that jump back to the video position
Generate model summaries, translations and image OCR
Split books into chapter notes and notes into Canvas boards
disambiguation: Not a video editor; it plays videos and writes timestamped notes from them.
extras: Desktop only (needs Electron). Bilibili timestamps come from an internal timer and are approximate; Douyin and netdisk links usually yield only title/cover or metadata; PDF book splitting is not implemented.
motivation: Bilibili videos mostly have no captions and yt-dlp only lists danmaku streams, so the author added a local Whisper transcription bridge.
problem: Watching a video and writing timestamped notes in Obsidian means switching apps and copying links and quotes by hand.

relations.evidence: aidenlx/media-extended —— 媒体播放 + 时间戳笔记的产品形态
larryxu001/video-transcript-obsidian-fetch —— 字幕优先、无字幕再转写的取舍
vancoder4-cyber/anycontent-obsidian-importer —— 多平台链接统一成 Markdown 的思路

summary: Desktop-only plugin that plays videos in a separate window and turns links, books and images into notes with timestamps, AI summaries and Canvas boards.
